source: Regulations for the FIFA World Cup 26 (May 2026), Annexe C
description: All 495 possible combinations of the eight best third-placed teams and which group winner each plays in the round of 32.
note: Each option maps a qualified group winner (e.g. '1A' = winner of Group A) to the third-placed team they face (e.g. '3E' = third-placed team from Group E).
